name: feedback-panel
description: Bulk feedback from Daniel on long lists: Claude writes items as JSON, feedback-panel serves a local form where each item gets an answer from a set (Remove / Keep for now / Ask me, Keep / Archive / Delete, Approve / Revise / Reject, priority, rating), a tick box or free text; search, filters, notes, Claude's suggestion tags, number keys, autosave, Submit. Claude reads the answers, acts, and writes per-item outcomes the page shows. Templates and a library of kept forms (with recipes to rebuild their items) live in Feedback-Panel-Templates; skills feedback-panel, feedback-form-template, feedback-form-library.
